text:
Providing deserving Veterans who qualify for our program with a much needed service dog is costly. HK9 raises funds through grants, corporate donations and matches, fundraisers and personal donations. As a way for you to help, as well as spread the world about HK9, we want you to wear our swag! Look through what we have to offer, and on a “donation” basis, YOU can help fund our next service team as well as get some great gear and other products!
To purchase, simply click the “Browse Now” button. You will be taken to Links Ink website to find that next piece of swag for your arsenal.
LINKS INK
What a great business! Links Ink has been a partner of Hk9 for a long time now. We have partnered with them for all of our events. Hoodies, hats, polos, they are all we will use!
Check them out and let them know we sent you!
Thank you for helping HK9! To order, simply click the button below! Your donation will go through paypal. In the comment section when paying, tell us what you want… size, color and any special instructions and we will get it out to you. We will make every effort to get it out to you ASAP. All orders are custom made so please allow a couple of weeks for delivery.
Not local to the 4 state area? Please add $5 for shipping and make sure to include a good address.
BROWSE NOW
